# Jennifer Bridge

Jennifer Bridge is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 1999.

Jennifer Bridge has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jennifer-bridge#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 68.7% of the ballot.

* * *

* * *

## Election History

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Helier No 2](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier-no-2) (3 seats), 27th November 2002.

**Jennifer Bridge was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 in 2002**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Jennifer Bridge** |  | 785 | 68.7% |
| 2 | **[Terry Le Main](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/terry-le-main)** |  | 658 | 57.6% |
| 3 | **[Geoff Southern](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern)** |  | 609 | 53.3% |
| 4 | [Ian McFirbishigh](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-mcfirbishigh) |  | 577 | 50.5% |

1,143 ballots (inc. 5 spoilt papers)

3,526 registered voters

= 32.4% turnout
